Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 3, 6.2, 11.2-11.3; court K. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2A5HGJ0MM1X7N8Z5EAZBD; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7CYNA8C2B3DV534449E3, bd-01M35A7EEC15KAFN2K1M5EFCAH, bd-01M35A7DJX9CXQ84FKBFV401G5.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own final integrated visual/accessibility evidence across the four mockup configurations. Reuse component courts and the interaction-hardening obligations. Inspect rendered product, not generated mockup pixels; retain DPR2 review alongside ordinary DPR1 readability.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Batch desktop 1600/1440, 1024, narrow and 200% zoom views; no obscured evidence actions, header drift, clipped labels or lost selection.
2. Keyboard/table completes evidence-return-export, visible focus, drawer return and reading order; actual contrast, monochrome status and reduced motion are checked.
3. Fix discovered failures through bounded owner tasks and rerun affected courts; browser ownership audit/cleanup and exact fixture/revision captures are archived.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Retain accessible list/reading alternatives and qualify only supported layouts; no pixel-only scientific claims.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [UX] Qualify the four configurations across layout, keyboard and contrast
